Greet someone by name.

READS    the name argument, else $MYCLI_NAME
WRITES   nothing
NEVER    makes a network call

Usage:
  mycli hello [name] [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help    help for hello
      --shout   upper-case the greeting

Global Flags:
      --dry-run            where supported: full validation, no writes
      --json               emit a machine-readable result envelope on stdout
      --log-level string   stderr log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
      --quiet              equivalent to --log-level error
